hints.title: Column Type Conversion
hints.text: Numerical columns represented as floating point values often need truncation to integer types. Which method casts columns to specified target data types?

hints.title: Targeted Column Casting
hints.text: The astype method accepts a dictionary mapping column names to target data types such as int or int64.

hints.title: Type Specification Syntax
hints.text: Call students.astype({'grade': int}) to cast the grade column to integer format while preserving all other column datatypes.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of records in students table
complexity.notes: Single vector pass over the target column allocating the converted integer array buffer.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Looping through elements with apply or list comprehensions loses numpy vectorized casting performance.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Allocating the new integer column buffer requires O(N) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of vectorized astype with dictionary mapping to cleanly update column schema.
